input_roles: latest eligible Version A ACS/PUMS payment and debt-service benchmarks
formula: Carry each latest eligible structural level and its bounds to every target month without interpolation
benchmark_rule: Rebenchmark only when a newly eligible anchor appears
missing_value_policy: Emit null before the anchor source period and preserve anchor null bounds sample and coverage

input_roles: latest eligible Version A annual HMDA rates and below-threshold shares
formula: Repeat the latest eligible annual county rate or share as a monthly level without division or interpolation
benchmark_rule: Every carried central value and bound equals its eligible Version A annual counterpart
missing_value_policy: Preserve suppressed or low-sample nulls plus sample N and coverage

input_roles: canonical flow contract with no exact monthly financed purchase-dollar volume
formula: Emit explicit null canonical rows rather than allocating an annual flow or substituting a proxy
benchmark_rule: The Version A annual HMDA flow is a benchmark mapping only and does not populate canonical monthly values

input_roles: latest eligible Version A annual HMDA flow plus eligible Redfin homes-sold and median-price snapshot
formula: Scale complete same-year Redfin sales-value proxy weights to annual central low and high HMDA flow values and assign the floating residual to the last finalized month
benchmark_rule: Each finalized twelve-month central low and high proxy sum equals its eligible annual counterpart exactly
missing_value_policy: Preserve null when annual proxy weights are incomplete or the target month proxy is unavailable

concept: canonical calibrated debt normalized debt equity and leverage targets
input_roles: canonical target contract with no universe-compatible calibrated debt anchor
formula: Emit explicit null canonical debt normalized equity real-dollar LTV and equity-rate rows rather than substituting a PMMS sensitivity
missing_value_policy: Flag calibrated_debt_anchor_unavailable and mark unavailable rows as not nowcasts

input_roles: carried aggregate P&I and bounds plus latest eligible Freddie Mac PMMS rate
formula: Capitalize central low and high payment values with matching fixed 20-year 25-year or 30-year annuity factors at the last PMMS observation available by the cutoff and target month
benchmark_rule: PMMS outputs remain separately labeled sensitivities and never populate canonical calibrated debt
missing_value_policy: Preserve null when payment or an eligible PMMS rate is unavailable

concept: benchmarked composite raw PMMS debt sensitivity
input_roles: latest eligible Version A raw-debt level anchor plus payment central low and high plus latest eligible Freddie Mac PMMS rate
formula: Build the 25-year central 20-year low and 30-year high envelopes at the anchor reference month and scale each path separately through the cutoff vintage
benchmark_rule: Central low and high equal the eligible Version A raw-debt value and bounds exactly at the reference month while remaining outside canonical calibrated debt
missing_value_policy: Emit explicit null rather than an unbenchmarked level when the raw anchor reference envelope payment bound or eligible PMMS rate is unavailable

input_roles: eligible matched owner-value anchor and bounds plus eligible county HPI snapshot plus matching PMMS debt sensitivity
formula: Update matched owner-value central low and high by a cutoff-safe HPI ratio then subtract debt central debt-high for low and debt-low for high
benchmark_rule: Debt plus central scenario equity equals the matched central HPI-updated owner-value stock
missing_value_policy: Preserve null before eligible inputs or where county HPI or required bounds are missing
